title: Notice Charge Computation Standard — Nights Kept, Nights Paid and Amount
content:
# Notice charge — computation standard

This standard sets how the notice charge on a cancelled reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category is computed. All dates are those recorded on the stay; the cancellation date is the date part of the cancellation time.

## Formal clause

1. **Nights kept.** The nights the cancellation keeps are the nights up to and including the cancellation date, the notice nights, which are the first 1 night dated after the cancellation date and before the check-out date, and every later night of the stay.
2. **Nights paid, in date order.** The nightly amounts collected pay for the stay's nights in date order: on a stay paid in monthly installments every installment collected covers the policy's nights per installment, counted from the check-in date (never more nights than the stay has); on a pay-part-now stay installment 1 pays the policy's deposit percentage of every night and the balance pays the rest; on any other stay installment 1 pays every night; no night is paid before installment 1 is collected. The installments collected are the scheduled installment collections on the stay's ledger; a collection filed as installment 0 for an alteration price increase is not one of them.
3. **Night price.** Each night is priced at the stay's night price, the nightly subtotal divided by the stay's nights and rounded half up to the cent.
4. **Nightly amount.** The notice charge collects the price of the nights kept (the nights kept times the night price, to the cent) less the nightly amounts collected, taken to the cent and never below 0.00.
5. **Fees and credits when installment 1 was never collected.** When installment 1 has not been collected, the notice charge also collects the cleaning fee and the share of the pet and extra-guest fees that the nights kept bear to the stay's nights (that is, the pet fee plus the extra-guest fee, times the nights kept, divided by the stay's nights), the fees taken together to the cent; and it is reduced by the Roamhaven Rewards credits redeemed on the stay and not yet reinstated (credits redeemed on the stay less credits reinstated on it, never less than zero). When installment 1 has been collected, the notice charge collects no fees and takes off no credits.
6. **Guest service fee.** The guest service fee on the notice charge is 14.20 percent of the notice charge's fee base, the nightly amount and the fees it collects, rounded half up to the cent.
7. **Occupancy tax.** The occupancy tax on the notice charge is the percentage rate of the notice charge's fee base plus the flat amount for each night it charges, rounded half up to the cent; the nights it charges are its nightly amount divided by the night price. The rate and the flat amount are those the occupancy tax schedule of the booking terms sets for the jurisdiction recorded on the stay:

| Jurisdiction recorded on the stay | Percentage rate | Flat amount per night |
|---|---|---|
| TX-AUSTIN | 17.00% | 0.00 |
| FL-ORANGE | 12.50% | 0.00 |
| CO-DENVER | 15.75% | 0.00 |
| TN-NASHVILLE | 15.25% | 2.50 |
| HI-HONOLULU | 17.96% | 0.00 |
| CA-SAN-DIEGO | 12.50% | 0.00 |

8. **The charge.** The notice charge is the nightly amount and the fees it collects plus that guest service fee and that occupancy tax, the fee and the tax each rounded half up to the cent, less those credits, and never below 0.00.

## Worked figure (hypothetical stay)

A hypothetical 10-night stay in TN-NASHVILLE, paid in full, nightly subtotal 1,500.00, cleaning fee 120.00, pet fee 50.00, no extra-guest fee, no Rewards credits. The collection of installment 1 was declined and never made good; the guest cancels on the stay's third night.

| Item | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Nights kept | 3 nights up to and including the cancellation date, 1 notice night, 6 later nights | 10 nights |
| Night price | 1,500.00 divided by 10 | 150.00 |
| Price of the nights kept | 10 times 150.00 | 1,500.00 |
| Nightly amounts collected | installment 1 never collected | 0.00 |
| Nightly amount | 1,500.00 less 0.00 | 1,500.00 |
| Fees | cleaning 120.00, plus pet 50.00 times 10 divided by 10 | 170.00 |
| Fee base | 1,500.00 plus 170.00 | 1,670.00 |
| Guest service fee | 14.20% of 1,670.00 | 237.14 |
| Occupancy tax | 15.25% of 1,670.00 is 254.675, plus 2.50 for each of the 10 nights charged, 25.00 | 279.68 |
| Notice charge | 1,670.00 plus 237.14 plus 279.68 | 2,186.82 |

The same stay with different collections on file:

| Collections on the stay's ledger | Nightly amounts collected | Notice charge |
|---|---|---|
| pay-part-now, installment 1 at a 50.00% deposit collected, balance not collected | 750.00 | nightly amount 750.00; fee 106.50; tax 114.375 plus 2.50 times 5 nights, 126.88; total 983.38 |
| paid in full, installment 1 collected | 1,500.00 | 0.00 |
